purpose: 沿用PDF技能只读核2020Q4原表及当前审批方法，不修改原PDF
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,hashlib,pdfplumber
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'reports/research/510300_bank_loan_approval_conditions_source_v1'
p=root/'reports/research/510300_bankers_loan_demand_source_qualification_v1/sources/2020Q4.pdf'
renders=out/'rendered_2020Q4_original';renders.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows=[]
with pdfplumber.open(p) as pdf:
 for i in [2,4]:
  dest=renders/f'原PDF第{i+1}页.png';assert not dest.exists()
  pdf.pages[i].to_image(resolution=140).save(dest)
  b=dest.read_bytes();rows.append({'pdf_page_1based':i+1,'path':dest.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)})
rec={'rendered_at':datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),'original_pdf_path':p.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'original_pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'original_pages':[3,5],'renders':rows,'source_PDF_edited':False,'new_network_requests':0,'new_fits':0}
rp=out/'同一2020Q4审批原页渲染回执.json';assert not rp.exists();rp.write_text(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('同一原2020Q4第3页审批表和第5页方法已渲染，原PDF不改。')
